provenance.note: Deterministic synthetic wide universe (P35 wide-universe recipe). BTC prices from tests/fixtures/wide_bab_universe.csv. Asset returns = beta * BTC_return + idio, idio ~ N(0, 0.003), betas linspace(0.35, 1.9, 40). Regimes are causal and lagged: trailing BTC trend (bull/bear) x trailing realized-vol tercile (low/mid/high), computed only from data available at t-1, no lookahead. Not real market data; not market profitability evidence. The verdict is honest and may be negative (a thin regime can fail deflation).
